title: cephaelis umbellata
intro: Cephaelis umbellata, commonly known as Goldthread, is a perennial plant species in the family Gesneriaceae, native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, skin conditions, and oral infections, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis umbellata are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Goldthread include iridoid glycosides, specifically harpagoside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
